summary: UMB Financial Corp filed an 8-K reporting quarterly results and declaring routine quarterly dividends. The press release covers Q2 2026 earnings, with a shareholder conference call scheduled the next day. The Board declared a $0.50 per share common dividend payable October 1, 2026, and a $193.75 per share Series B preferred dividend equating to $0.484375 per depositary share, payable October 15, 2026. No special-situation activity is present — the filing consists of standard operational updates and ordinary dividend declarations. The event is routine for a public bank holding company and does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, strategic initiatives, or other special-situation categories.
